reason: Well made Deco style combination bookcase with curved shelves, decorative and in demand, maker unknown.

The 'Deco style' wording is the cataloguer's; no maker or date is supported by any mark. Title sizes (H90 W104 D30 cm) look about right for the proportions.
condition: Good overall with normal scratches, scuffs and patchy finish. Door glass looks intact. A string is tied to the lock, possibly holding the key.
